title: HIV protease inhibitor saquinavir inhibits toll-like receptor 4 activation by targeting receptor dimerization.
authors: Yao, Kai; Wang, Zheng; Peng, Cheng; Wang, Yong; Xue, Bichen; Tang, Yulin; Wang, Zhichao; Xu, Hongbo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HIV蛋白酶抑制剂沙奎那韦通过靶向TLR4受体二聚化抑制其激活，涉及分子对接但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) is crucial in induction of innate immune response through recognition of invading pathogens or endogenous alarming molecules. Ligand-triggered dimerization of TLR4 is essential for the activation of NF-kappaB and IRF3 through MyD88- or TRIF-dependent pathways. Saquinavir (SQV), an FDA-approved HIV protease inhibitor, has been shown to attenuate the activation of NF-kappaB induced by HMGB1 by blocking TLR4-MyD88 association in proteasome independent pathway. This study aims to define whether SQV is an HMGB1-specific and MyD88-dependent TLR4 signaling inhibitor and which precise signaling element of TLR4 is targeted by SQV. MATERIALS AND METHODS: PMA differentiated human THP-1 macrophages or reconstituted HEK293 cells were pretreated with SQV before stimulated by different TLR agonists. TNF-alpha level was evaluated through ELISA assay. NF-kappaB activation was analyzed using NF-kappaB SEAP reporting system. The levels of MyD88/TRIF pathways-related factors were examined by immunoblot. TLR4 endocytosis was assessed by immunocytochemistry. TLR4 dimerization was determined using immunoprecipitation between different tagged TLR4 and an in silico molecular docking experiment was performed to explore the possible binding site of SQV on its target. RESULTS: Our data showed that SQV suppresses both MyD88- and TRIF-dependent pathways in response to lipopolysaccharide (LPS), a critical sepsis inducer and TLR4 agonist, leading to downregulation of NF-kappaB and IRF3. SQV did not suppress MyD88-dependent pathway triggered by TLR1/2 agonist Pam3csk4. In the only TRIF-dependent pathway, SQV did not alleviate IRF3 phosphorylation induced by TLR3 agonist Poly(I:C). Furthermore, dimerization of TLR4 following LPS or HMGB1 stimulation was decreased by SQV. CONCLUSION: We concluded that TLR4 receptor complex is one of the mammalian targets of SQV, and TLR4-mediated immune responses and consequent risk for uncontrolled inflammation could be modulated by FDA-approved drug SQV.
abstract_zh: 目的：Toll样受体4（TLR4）在通过识别入侵病原体或内源性警报分子诱导先天免疫应答中至关重要。配体触发的TLR4二聚化对于通过MyD88或TRIF依赖性途径激活NF-kappaB和IRF3至关重要。沙奎那韦（SQV）是一种FDA批准的HIV蛋白酶抑制剂，已被证明通过阻断TLR4-MyD88关联以蛋白酶体非依赖性途径减弱HMGB1诱导的NF-kappaB激活。本研究旨在确定SQV是否为HMGB1特异性和MyD88依赖性的TLR4信号抑制剂，以及SQV靶向TLR4的哪个精确信号元件。材料与方法：PMA分化的THP-1巨噬细胞或重构的HEK293细胞在不同TLR激动剂刺激前用SQV预处理。通过ELISA评估TNF-alpha水平。使用NF-kappaB SEAP报告系统分析NF-kappaB激活。通过免疫印迹检测MyD88/TRIF途径相关因子的水平。通过免疫细胞化学评估TLR4内吞作用。通过不同标记TLR4之间的免疫沉淀确定TLR4二聚化，并进行计算机分子对接实验以探索SQV在其靶标上的可能结合位点。结果：我们的数据显示，SQV抑制了由脂多糖（LPS）——一种关键的败血症诱导剂和TLR4激动剂——触发的MyD88和TRIF依赖性途径，导致NF-kappaB和IRF3下调。SQV未抑制由TLR1/2激动剂Pam3csk4触发的MyD88依赖性途径。在仅TRIF依赖性途径中，SQV未减轻由TLR3激动剂Poly(I:C)诱导的IRF3磷酸化。此外，LPS或HMGB1刺激后的TLR4二聚化被SQV减少。结论：我们得出结论，TLR4受体复合物是SQV的哺乳动物靶标之一，且TLR4介导的免疫应答及随之而来的失控性炎症风险可通过FDA批准的药物SQV进行调节。
